label: 四足跪姿 + 单腿外展
pose_lead: Grounded pose, quadruped kneel with one leg abducted:
lower_limbs: One knee supports on the ground while the other hip opens outward, that knee bent and lifted away to the side.
upper_limbs: Both hands press the ground, arms nearly vertical to the floor.
torso_head: The torso lies close to horizontal with a slight arch in the back; the head turns to face the front of the frame.
weight_silhouette: A classic three- or four-point support with the seat held high; the side-lifted knee gives the pose a clear asymmetry.
